description: 20 new same-author questions over frozen real upstream source files; no claim of blind independent acceptance. Gold is evidence presence, not generated answer correctness.

cases.question: Does Black --diff overwrite my file, where is the diff printed, and how do I request colors?

required.quote: Don't write the files back, just output a diff
They are printed to stdout
If you'd like colored diffs, you can enable them with `--color`.

cases.question: Как считаются границы --line-ranges в Black? Можно ли указать несколько диапазонов и форматировать несколько файлов или notebooks?

required.quote:
The
`<START>` and `<END>` integer indices are 1-based and inclusive on both ends.
This option can be specified multiple times, and a union of the lines will be formatted.

Formatting more than one file or any Jupyter Notebooks with this option is not
supported.

cases.question: Can --required-version pin only a major Black version, can it live in configuration, and why is it useful?

required.quote: You can also pass just the major version:

This option can be set in a
configuration file for consistent results across environments.
all contributors to your project are using the same version

cases.question: An editor pipes Python code to Black through stdin. How should it supply the filename so --force-exclude is respected?

required.quote:
The name of the file when passing it through stdin. Useful to make sure Black will
respect the `--force-exclude` option on some editors that rely on using stdin.

cases.question: Which Poetry command deletes all virtual environments, and what happens if the active environment is removed?

required.quote: poetry env remove --all
If you remove the currently activated virtual environment, it will be automatically deactivated.

cases.question: При virtualenvs.create=false куда Poetry установит зависимости, если окружений нет? Что меняется, когда окружение уже активировано?

required.quote: otherwise it will install dependencies into the systems python environment.

If Poetry detects it's running within an activated virtual environment, it will never create a new virtual environment,
regardless of the value set for `virtualenvs.create`.

cases.question: For local path dependencies, how do project and tool.poetry declarations differ, how is editable mode enabled, and what must change before distribution?

required.quote: In the `project` section, you can only use absolute paths:
my-package = { path = "../my-package/", develop = true }

Before distributing your project, publish each path dependency and replace
the path with a version constraint.

cases.question: How does solver.lazy-wheel fetch metadata, when does it make no difference, and what exact speedup percentage is guaranteed?

required.quote:
[HTTP range requests](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Range_requests)
to only download the METADATA files of wheels.

If the cache has already been filled or the server does not support HTTP range requests,
this setting makes no difference.

cases.question: How are environment constants referenced in HTML, and how do missing variables behave differently in HTML and JavaScript?

required.quote: a special `%CONST_NAME%` syntax
it will be ignored and not replaced, unlike `import.meta.env.NON_EXISTENT` in JS where it's replaced as `undefined`.

cases.question: Для new URL(imagePath, import.meta.url) Vite преобразует произвольный imagePath при сборке? Почему шаблон не подходит для SSR?

required.quote: However, the URL string must be static so it can be analyzed, otherwise the code will be left as is
This pattern does not work if you are using Vite for Server-Side Rendering, because `import.meta.url` has different semantics in browsers vs. Node.js.

cases.question: What does .example.com mean in server.allowedHosts, and why should true not replace an explicit allowlist?

required.quote: `.example.com` will allow `example.com`, `foo.example.com`, and `foo.bar.example.com`.
Setting `server.allowedHosts` to `true` allows any website to send requests to your dev server through DNS rebinding attacks, allowing them to download your source code and content.

cases.question: Does server.fs.deny take precedence over fs.allow, and does the deny list protect files in the public directory?

required.quote: This will have higher priority than [`server.fs.allow`](#server-fs-allow).
This blocklist does not apply to [the public directory](/guide/assets.md#the-public-directory).

cases.question: What is the default cache strategy, and why might content be preferable after git clone changes modification times?

required.quote: **Default Value**: `metadata`
The `content` strategy can be useful in cases where the modification time of your files changes even if their contents have not.

cases.question: ESLint --quiet только скрывает предупреждения или также отключает запуск warn-правил?

required.quote: This option allows you to disable reporting on warnings and running of rules set to warn.
only errors are reported by ESLint and only rules set to error will be run.

cases.question: Where are globalIgnores patterns resolved with the normal config versus an alternate --config, and what base does --ignore-pattern use?

required.quote: glob patterns are evaluated relative to the `eslint.config.js` file.

When using `globalIgnores()` in an alternate configuration file specified using the [`--config`](../command-line-interface#-c---config) command line option, glob patterns are evaluated relative to the current working directory.
When using [`--ignore-pattern`](../command-line-interface#--ignore-pattern), glob patterns are evaluated relative to the current working directory.

cases.question: Why combine --no-warn-ignored with --max-warnings 0 when explicitly passing an ignored filename?

required.quote: This option suppresses both `File ignored by default` and `File ignored because of a matching ignore pattern` warnings when an ignored filename is passed explicitly.
it will prevent exit code 1 due to the aforementioned warning.

cases.question: When using recompose=True, what happens to child widget state and should I retain child references or query again?

required.quote: any child widgets will have their state reset after a recompose.
You should avoid storing a reference to child widgets when using recompose.
Better to [query](../guide/queries.md) for a child widget when you need them.

cases.question: В каком порядке вызываются compute, validate и watch? Почему нельзя делать тяжёлые вычисления в compute?

required.quote: Textual will first attempt to call the compute method for a reactive attribute, followed by the validate method, and finally the watch method.
Textual calls compute methods on an object when _any_ reactive attribute changes.

cases.question: For a regular worker function, when is thread=True required, how is cancellation checked, and can post_message be called from the worker?

required.quote: Textual will raise an exception if you add the `work` decorator to a regular function without `thread=True`.
you *can* manually check if the worker was cancelled.
[post_message][textual.widget.Widget.post_message] which *is* thread-safe.

cases.question: What does Input valid_empty=True do to validators, and what maximum validation latency in milliseconds is guaranteed?

required.quote: empty values will bypass any validators, and empty values will be considered valid.
